dashboard.getStarted: Start by adding your first bike
dashboard.proTipBody: Adding components (chain, cassette, tires) lets <1>BikeCheck</1> predict maintenance based on real-world mileage.

rides.emptyBody: Connect your Strava account or record your first ride to start tracking mileage and component wear.

service.emptyBody: Add your bike first — to start adding services and monitoring maintenance health and precision mileage.

bikes.emptyBody: Connect your Strava account or manually add a bike to start tracking component health and service intervals.
bikes.intro: Manage your high-performance machines and their technical health.
bikes.loadFailed: Your bikes could not be loaded. Please try again.
bikes.detailComingSoon: The full bike detail is coming soon.
bikes.deleteConfirmBody: The bike is removed from your garage along with its components. Rides already recorded stay in your history.
bikes.deleteFailed: Could not delete the bike. Try again.

addBike.title: Add new bike
addBike.identityTitle_step1: Step 1: Try to find your bike detail
addBike.identityBody_step1: Enter your bike details to try find technical specifications
addBike.identityBody_step2: Specify your bike's category and other parameters.
addBike.awaitingSpecs: Awaiting details to fetch component specs...
addBike.searchFailedBody: Unable to connect to the bike database. We couldn't retrieve the technical specification right now.
addBike.searchEmptyBody: We found no bike for that brand, model and year. Check the details, or continue by entering them manually.
addBike.cropBody: Pinch or use the slider to zoom, then drag the bike into the frame.
addBike.selectModelBody: We found multiple matches for your scan. Please verify the exact model below to ensure correct component tracking.
addBike.componentsBody: These parts were found for your bike. They will be tracked for service and wear.
addBike.componentsFailedBody: We couldn't load the component list for this bike. You can continue and add parts later.
addBike.componentsEmptyBody: This bike has no component list. You can add parts later.
addBike.saveFailed: The bike could not be saved. Please try again.
addBike.addedBody: Your bike is in the garage. From now on you can track every service, keep an eye on component wear, and watch your costs add up — all in one place.
addBike.stravaBenefitLifespan: Estimated lifespan based on your performance

strava.connectedBody: Your rides will sync automatically from now on. Mileage and component wear fill themselves in.
strava.connectFailed: Could not open Strava. Try again.
strava.pitchBody: Track component wear automatically, based on your real activities.
strava.gearLinkingBody: Match your bikes to your Strava gear so rides land on the right bike.
strava.gearLinkingNoGear: You have no gear on Strava yet. Add a bike in your Strava profile, then come back.
strava.gearLinkingFailed: Could not save the pairing. Try again.
strava.unpairBikeNote: Unpairing stops new rides from syncing. Rides already recorded stay on this bike.
strava.disconnectConfirmBody: New rides will stop syncing to your bikes. Rides already recorded stay, and you can connect again at any time.
strava.unpairedBikesBody: Connecting with Strava gear automates mileage tracking and service reminders for your bikes without picking a right bike after every ride.
strava.gearLinkingLoadFailed: Could not load your Strava gear. Try again.

notifications.emptyBody: Anything that happens to your bikes or rides shows up here.
